summary: Catanduanes representative with 207 principal-authored bills. Authored senior citizen electricity and water discounts, enhanced senior and PWD discounts, employment opportunities for seniors and direct delivery of senior stipends. Co-authored the national minimum wage and two electric cooperative franchises.
caveat: Evidence is concentrated on seniors' benefits; only 7 rubric bills surfaced from 207.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored senior citizen utility discounts, enhanced senior and PWD discounts and direct delivery of stipends (-2, social provision); co-authored the national minimum wage (-2).
